notes: THE FIXED-ASSET REGISTER NOW STOPS WHEN IT CANNOT READ YOUR DEPRECIATION HISTORY. Every figure on that screen is built from the depreciation already charged. If that history cannot be read, MoRaj Ledger now refuses to run depreciation, dispose an asset, revalue one, or change a cost or opening figure — and tells you why. Before, the register simply showed every asset as never depreciated, so an annual run could charge months that were already charged, and a disposal could write back accumulated depreciation the ledger does not hold. The refusal now sits in the posting itself, not only on the buttons, so a form already open on screen when the fault appears cannot slip through. YOUR ARCHIVED DOCUMENTS ARE REACHABLE AGAIN. Once a vault held more than 500 attachments, the "Show archived" tick box disappeared, and archived documents could not be listed, opened or restored from that screen. Archiving is how a wrongly-attached receipt comes off a voucher without destroying the evidence behind it, so this mattered most on the fullest vaults. The archive is now read directly, and the heading no longer reports "0 attachment(s)" over a full table when a count cannot be read. LONG LISTS NOW SAY WHAT THEY ARE NOT SHOWING. The audit log, cheques, lodgements, exchange rates, invoices, petty cash vouchers, staff advances and vendor bills state the true total when the list is shortened, and name the report that reads everything. The cheque register's message was rewritten: that list already shows EVERY OUTSTANDING CHEQUE whatever its age, so only a settled or cancelled cheque can fall outside it and your reconciliation was never at risk. UNDOING A REVALUATION NO LONGER DESTROYS THE OPENING DEPRECIATION. For an asset carried in from your previous system that figure is usually most of its accumulated depreciation, and it was being lost permanently. A HALF-FINISHED REQUISITION CONVERSION CAN NO LONGER HOLD YOUR BUDGET TWICE — the commitment now records which requisition raised it. AND SCREENS THAT HAD NOTHING TO SHOW sometimes said "nothing has been recorded yet" when the real reason was a filter, the archived view, or a read that failed. They now say which. DATABASE CHANGE: two small additions that only add columns — your books and settings are untouched, and this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first: Backup & Export, Back up now.
